scope: Receiver-owned import and association of selected compiled API and configured MCP sources, using the same public package and pinned interpreters.

boundary.inspect: No birth, grant, source invocation or association before explicit connect consent
boundary.configuration: Only canonical selection and declared public package members; no sender keys, roots, grants, secret locators, headers or environment
boundary.authority: Association narrows routing; it is not authorization. Existing local access, action cards, compilation and Bound verification remain required
boundary.identity: Selection plus public lock by digest. Runtime closure separately pinned. ZIP identity is separate.
boundary.import: Reuse the ordinary received/connect path; verify source pins before recording receiver association
boundary.runtime: Only allowlisted pinned runtime members; no install, script execution or arbitrary dependency discovery
boundary.sourcePolicy: Compiled source pins include declared source output and read/write intervals; local output-presence facts are excluded
boundary.network: Tests contact local fixtures only; installing or inspecting does not invoke a source

open: Final installed delivery and CI verification
